verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity documents an id_number verification session type that checks a user's name, date of birth and national ID number without a document scan, and it explicitly validates SSNs. That is a first-party, document-free data check. missing for 10: details on which authoritative databases or registries are queried and in which countries, any credit-header data source, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the id_number flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can verify identity against authoritative databases without documents — SSN, national registries, or credit-header data — for lower-friction flows where a doc scan is overkill

citations.quote: id_number - Verify a user’s name, date of birth and national ID number.
